author: Swinhoe, 1871
status: 길잃은새, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 기록을 검토하는 중
summary: 우리나라에는 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새로, 물가 모래땅이나 자갈밭, 농경지 등에서 지낸다. 중앙아시아와 몽골, 중국 북부에서 번식하고 남쪽으로 내려가 겨울을 난다. 번식기는 4~6월이고 한배에 알을 3~4개 낳는다.

points.en: small dark brown spots on the upper breast

art.subject: Asian Short-toed Lark (Alaudala cheleensis), adult (sexes alike) in spring: upperparts pale sandy grey-brown, finely streaked dark brown on the crown and back; pale sandy lores and supercilium; sandy-white cheeks, chin and throat; a gorget of small, fine dark brown streaks across the upper breast; underparts otherwise sandy white, the flanks sandy buff with fine dark streaks; uppertail coverts slightly buffier. Tail dark brown with white outer feathers. Short, stubby, pale horn bill with a darker upper ridge; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: standing on bare sandy ground, side view
art.scene: Korean spring riverside sand and gravel flats next to farmland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on sand: sandy grey-brown streaked upperparts, pale sandy supercilium, fine dark streaks across the upper breast, buff flanks with fine dark streaks, primary tips projecting beyond the tertials
adult, head and breast detail: pale sandy lores and supercilium, sandy-white cheeks and throat, band of small dark brown streaks on the upper breast, short stubby bill
art.build: Small lark about the size of a sparrow and clearly smaller than the Eurasian Skylark; compact, round-headed and short-necked, with no crest; the crown feathers lie flat. Bill short, conical and stubby, pale horn, much shorter than the head. Legs short, pinkish. At rest the primary tips project visibly beyond the tertials. Tail of medium length, dark with white outer edges. Walks and runs on bare sand and gravel, crouching low.
avoid: Do not paint a dark patch at the side of the neck or long tertials covering the wingtip; those mark the Greater Short-toed Lark (Calandrella brachydactyla).
Do not give it a crest or a long bill like the Eurasian Skylark or Crested Lark.
Do not paint a thin pipit bill or a heavily streaked breast.
Do not make it rufous or dark brown; it is pale, sandy grey-brown.
